name: Somaliland
summary: Green, white and red horizontal bands, with the Shahada in white on the green and a black star in the white. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 but is not internationally recognised.
origin: Somaliland, the former British Somaliland Protectorate, declared independence from Somalia in 1991 after the collapse of the central government. Its flag was adopted on 14 October 1996.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood of those who died for independence.

symbols.name: Shahada
symbols.description: The Islamic declaration of faith in white Arabic script.

symbols.name: Black star
symbols.description: A five-pointed star in the white band.
symbols.meaning: The lost unity of the Somali people; black is a sign of mourning for the failed union.

facts: Somalia's flag has a white star on light blue; Somaliland's star is black as a sign of mourning.
Somaliland has held several peaceful elections despite lacking recognition.
Because of the Shahada, the flag is not lowered to half-mast.
clues: Green, white and red bands with white script in the green and a black star.
Its black star mourns a failed union.
It declared independence in 1991 but lacks recognition.
